context.args: Extend the Haiku question-classifier (currently workspace-worker-only in scripts/flow-worker-question-classifier.js) to also run in main/solo mode. In consumeAndTriggerRestart() in scripts/hooks/core/task-boundary-reset.js, before SIGTERM: if classifier detects the final assistant message ends with an open question to the user AND .workflow/state/pending-question.json is absent, auto-write the pending-question marker and defer restart with reason 'auto-deferred-question-detected'. Add config key for main-mode toggle (mirror workspace.aiWorkerQuestionClassifier shape). Goal: mechanically prevent the orphaned-question bug where the AI forgets to call `flow ask` before ending a turn with a text question, causing the task-boundary restart to fire and lose the user's answer.
